pages.title: Without a Sharp Edge
pages.text: Use safe transport and husbandry arrows against their actual eligible targets.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Leashing Arrow excludes villagers. The padded breeding arrow should not damage animals. Tracking Arrow follows the last mob hit: hit the intended target first.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Leashing and padded breeding arrows change target states; Tracking follows the last hit target.
